fact: Sidwaya reports the Direction générale des impôts officially launched SYC@D, a cloud platform integrating cadastre, domain and land processes, on 21 March 2025 in Ouagadougou, accessible at sif.bf.

Sidwaya reports the Prime Minister said SYC@D lets citizens and investors carry out land procedures online and track their files in real time, with cadastral extract requests handled in one day and definitive transfer orders (land titles) in 60 days at most.
The Direction Générale des Impôts says the Prime Minister launched SyC@D, the integrated cadastre and domain management system, on 21 March 2025 at sif.bf.
The DGI says SyC@D offers online request and issue of the parcel attribution certificate, provisional and definitive cession decrees and the cadastral extract.

The DGI director general says the DGI will work to integrate all procedures for an electronic land register (Livre foncier électronique) that will centralise all the country's land data and eventually allow fully digitalised land titles.

The LuxDev project sheet BKF/027 (Nov 2021 to Apr 2024, EUR 1.8m, at the Direction générale des impôts) says 13,293 land titles and 89,131 survey files were digitised in Ouagadougou and Bobo-Dioulasso, towards a multipurpose cadastre.
The Ministry of Economy and Finance says it launched SYC@D, the integrated cadastre and domain management system, on 21 March 2025 at sif.bf to process and issue land-occupation titles.
